name: Alternate Nostril Breathing

instructions.description: Sit comfortably with an upright relaxed posture.
Use one hand to gently close one nostril while inhaling through the open nostril.
Switch sides and exhale through the other nostril, then inhale through that same side.
Alternate sides smoothly for the planned practice time.

performanceMetrics.notes: Keep the breath smooth and unforced throughout the sequence.
Alternate inhale and exhale between nostrils in a steady rhythm.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Use simple bilateral breathing if the nostril pattern feels distracting.

commentsNotes: Skip the drill if nasal congestion prevents comfortable breathing.
